text:
maria: Heads-up — Acme Retail wants a Private VPC pod for Q4 (Black Fri week). They expect a 3-hour daily peak, ~2,000,000 requests in that peak window. Request: give a hardware sizing + GPU-hour forecast and cost ballpark. They care about p95 latency ~200ms and graceful degradation.

alan: ok, first pass numbers please. do they care about model family or we pick the best-cost/latency tradeoff?

maria: they prefer LLM performance similar to 13B–34B class; open to quantized 70B if it's cheaper but latency matters. Also on-prem only (air-gapped is a possibility).

kevin: quick calc: peak_rps = 2,000,000 / (3*3600) ≈ 185 rps. avg tokens: assume 90% prompt-only @350 tok and 10% chat @800 tok → avg_tokens ≈ 395. tokens/sec ≈ 185 * 395 ≈ 73,075 tok/s. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

jem: nice. what's reasonable tokens/sec per GPU? depends on model and quantization. give ranges for A100/H100/L40S.

kevin: from our bench: (very rough)
- A100 80GB (int8/quant): 6k–14k tok/s for 13B–34B depending on kernel set
- H100 80GB: 12k–28k tok/s
- L40S (cloud inference SKU): 8k–18k tok/s

kevin: using midpoints: A100 ~10k, H100 ~18k, L40S ~12k. GPUs_needed = ceil(73,075 / per_gpu_tok_s):
- A100 ~ 8 GPUs
- H100 ~ 5 GPUs
- L40S ~ 7 GPUs

alan: add redundancy + autoscale headroom. Recommend baseline = needed * 1.25 + 1 (N+1). So: A100 -> 11, H100 -> 7, L40S -> 10.

maria: convert to GPU-hours for a 30-day Black Fri month window (peak window 3h/day): gpu_hours = GPUs_reserved * peak_hours_per_day * days. Using H100 baseline 7 GPUs: 7 * 3 * 30 = 630 GPU-hours. Add 20% buffer for prep/maint → ~756 GPU-hours.

jem: for reserved capacity proposals we should also include warm pool for canaries and rolling upgrades. Add 1 extra full pod (~same size) if rollback must be instant. So recommend selling 8-gpu reserved pod (H100) for the customer.

alan: quick cost blurb for sales: internal procurement ranges (very approximate): $3–8 / GPU-hour depending on spot/RIs, on-prem financing. Using $5/hr midpoint: 756 * $5 ≈ $3,780 for the peak month (GPU cost only). Add networking, storage, ops (est. +30–50%).

sophie: sales note — customer asked for a fixed monthly commitment and SLA. We should show options: (a) dedicated 8xH100 reserved for peak month; (b) mixed baseline + burst to hosted Redwood for overflow; (c) smaller on-prem pool + routing policy to Hosted as fallback for non-sensitive traffic.

maria: networking notes: cross-AZ traffic can add jitter. Recommend single-AZ deployment for lowest p95 unless they accept <10ms cross-AZ variance. Also ensure 100Gb NICs and a fast NVMe cache layer for KV/prefix caching.

kevin: operational checklist:
- pre-warm KV cache window (we recommend 1–2h before peak start)
- autoscaler tune: based on token throughput, not just CPU. pref metric = tokens/sec or GPU_utilization with lower-bound scale-up trigger
- rolling canary policy: 10% traffic to new pod for 15–30m
- fallback policy: route to hosted Redwood with masked prompt if customer allows

infra-bot: quick disk estimate for model artifacts and cache: 3x model replicas + 1.5TB cache => recommend 5TB total persistent + 1TB ephemeral per node.

jem: we should provide customers a simple sizing estimator snippet. maria, can you add to the proposal doc?

maria: pasted estimator snip below (use in proposal)
```
# estimator (pseudo)
peak_rps = peak_requests / peak_window_seconds
avg_tokens = prompt_tok*prompt_frac + chat_tok*chat_frac
tokens_per_sec = peak_rps * avg_tokens
gpus_needed = ceil(tokens_per_sec / per_gpu_tok_s)
gpus_with_buffer = ceil(gpus_needed*1.25) + 1
gpu_hours_month = gpus_with_buffer * peak_hours_per_day * billing_days
```

alan: nice. also mention warm-up GPU-hours for model loading: ~0.5–1 GPU-hour per model load per node during deploys. Add to ops estimate.

kevin: risks to call out:
- model version regression under quantized kernels — include an eval suite in rollout
- network egress throttles if customer has shared fabric
- cooling/power constraints for on-prem racks if they buy H100s

sophie: action items for sales deck:
- 2 options (reserve 8xH100 pod) OR (6xH100 + hosted overflow)
- GPU-hours and ballpark cost
- SLA / rollback plan
- lead time for procurement (6–10 weeks for H100s)

maria: i'll draft the proposal today and include the estimator + slide with cost/time tradeoffs. tagging @jem to review ops/runbook. :thumbsup:

jem: will review and add canary + eval checklist.

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-4421 for on-prem network perf test and SKU procurement checklist.

alan: cool. if we want to tighten numbers we should run a short benchmark with their prompt set. action: schedule bench with customer sample requests this week.

maria: noted — i'll ask for 1k sample prompts. thanks all.

kevin: leaving a short note: if we push quant 70B on H100, the per-GPU tok/s could be higher; we should present both quantized 34B and 70B tradeoffs in the doc.

sophie: any objections to sharing the rough GPU-hour + cost calc with the customer now?

alan: fine as long as we mark numbers as estimated and include a bench line-item.

maria: agreed. sending proposal draft shortly.
